meta_description:
480K likes, 1,336 comments - ksi on September 17, 2026: "Ah man, this is a lot. Sway, Derek, thank you for everything you’ve done for me. You believed in me when many didn’t. You gave me a chance when many didn’t. Musically people laughed me off as a joke but you saw my potential and helped me grow as an artist. From smoke and mirrors to no sleep to Lamborghini you were there to help. It was so crazy because I was a fan of you. I remember I used your songs in my top 5 goals of the week videos back in the day and then the fact that you reached out to me to not only to thank me but to also help me musically…You were one of a kind man. 

I wish you were still here.

44 is too young to leave. You still had so much to do. You were like a father figure to me. Whenever I had problems or issues, I would go to your studio in London for advice and you always knew what to say.  This one hurts a lot. Just feel like this year is really testing me man. Life right now is just trying to make me break. But I know you’d say that I’m a fighter and that I’ll get through it, however it just gets harder and harder man. You’re a king Sway. I’ll never forget you. My heart breaks for all your children that will no longer have you there. And all your friends and family that will no longer get to see you anymore. It’s not fair. Life isn’t fair. You will always be a legend. 

RIP Derek".
